column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan alert thresholds.
#   WARN    - report it (job summary / PR comment / HTML report) but never
#             fail the job on its own
#   FAIL    - report it AND fail the job if it fires
# This is the DAST equivalent of the SAST severity-threshold env vars at the
# top of security-sast.yml: to make the scan stricter, flip more rules to
# FAIL; to cut noise on a rule you've triaged and accepted, set it to IGNORE
# or WARN. Full rule ID list: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/
# Ignored below because this app is a private, password-gated, two-user trip
# planner with no third-party embeds or cross-origin needs — these fire on
# effectively every page and add noise without changing what a fix would be.
# Anything not listed here uses ZAP's own default threshold and will show up
# as WARN in the report/job summary; add explicit FAIL rows for the alerts
# you want to hard-block a PR (e.g. SQL injection, XSS):
